We need to determine number of methyl (CH3) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see signals for CH3 (singlet, doublet, triplet). Could also use carbon NMR to see number of distinct methyl carbons. Probably easiest: get proton NMR and count distinct methyl signals (integrations). But we need integer count of methyl groups, not distinct types. Could use integration values.

We need to run proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed). It will return a string with peaks and maybe integration. Let's try.
